text:
emily chen: Heads-up — customer (EdgeCommerce) wants a quick pilot with coyote-11b-rlhf. Low-latency chat, sensitive PII, so Dedicated or Private. Can we do a fast bring-up + quant smoke and a small quality baseline?

ajay rao: Pinging infra for capacity. rough checklist: 1) model artifacts + hf repo 2) conversion to our runtime 3) quant smoke (4/5 bits) 4) basic eval suite (100 prompts) 5) perf & mem numbers.

sophia liu: I can own quant smoke + baseline eval. want to run 4-bit symmetric + 5-bit asymmetric. quick metric targets: <=1.2x token loss vs float and <10% drop in top-1 qa accuracy on our small devset.

emily chen: @sophia awesome. customer expects demo in ~7 business days. prioritize smoke; we can iterate on quality. Also need guidance on privacy mode for logs.

ajay rao: infra-bot — do we have a dedicated pool slot for a 11B trial? @infra-bot

infra-bot: scheduled: reserved-gpu-pool-40 for 24h window starting 2028-06-12T03:00Z. job placeholders allowed.

quant-bot: queued quant-run #18492: model=coyote-11b, qbits=[4,5], backend=awsmx, batch_sizes=[1,4,8], seed=42. ETA ~45m.

sophia liu: Quick note on artifact prep: repo has float fp16 weights + a patch for rotary scalings. I'll run conversion with our convert script:
```
./convert_to_redwood --model ./hf/coyote-11b --out ./artifacts/coyote-11b-redwood --dtype fp16 --fix-rotary
```
I'll attach hash + checksums when done.

kevin o'neil: For quality baseline, which eval sets? I'll run prod-like fewshot prompts + 100 targeted safety prompts. list: convo_safe_100, qa_dev_100, summarization_smoke_50.

emily chen: sounds good. Sophia, mark any failure modes (big logits collapse, hallucination spikes). If quant fails, we fallback to 5-bit or int8 hybrid.

sophia liu: noted. If 4-bit leads to >12% top1 drop, cut it and try 5-bit or group-wise quant.

quant-bot: update: job 18492 finished (status=partial_success). 4-bit had severe degradation on qa_dev_100. 5-bit asymmetric within threshold; latency improved ~1.8x vs fp16 at batch=1. detailed results: /runs/18492/results.json

ajay rao: copying results path to ticket INF-6792. Sophia, please post summary and attach the results snapshot; infra will stage dedicated instance for your 5-bit runs.

sophia liu: summary: 5-bit asymmetric chosen as default for pilot. metrics: qa_dev_top1: fp16=0.72, 5bit=0.66 (8.3% drop), perplexity delta +9%. latency: fp16=78ms/token, 5bit=44ms/token. memory: reduced ~36%. attaching short log snippet:
```
# run 18492 - 5bit summary
qa_dev_top1: 0.66
perplexity_delta: 1.09
latency_ms_per_token: 44
mem_peak_gb: 28.4
```

emily chen: great. Kevin — can you prep the demo harness with the 5-bit profile and scrub logs for PII? Also we need a short rollback plan if quality regressions show up post-demo.

kevin o'neil: will do. Demo harness: branch demo/coyote-pilot. Added privacy flag to drop user message bodies from logs and only keep metadata.

infra-bot: dedicated instance provisioned: rdw-ded-11b-06 (gpus: 4xA100-80GB), endpoint: rdw-ded-11b-06.internal:443.

emily chen: thanks team. Next actions: Sophia — finalize artifact + attach results; Kevin — demo harness + scrub; Ajay — keep infra on standby. I'll update customer next Monday with plan + demo slot. :thumbsup:

sophia liu: attaching artifacts + results to INF-6792 now. :white_check_mark:

kevin o'neil: nudged UX for demo creds.

emily chen: closing loop here. If any blocker, flag in this thread. :eyes:
